tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250sprul pa'i rgyal chen sku lnga'i gsol phrin dbang gi gad rgyangs zhes bya ba/1$0000300 na mo badz+ra ma hā kro dha ya/

dam rdzas mchod gtor bshams pa byin gyis brlabs te/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis zan yangs chos 'khor chen po sogs gar bzhugs kyi gnas nas sprul pa'i rgyal chen 'khor bcas spyan drangs par bsam la/ hūm̐/ chos nyid zhi las ma g.yos kyang*// rnam 'gyur 'bar ba'i skur ston pa// sprul pa'i chos skyong rgyal chen ni// sde lnga 'khor g.yog dpung dang bcas// sngon gyi thugs dam rgyud bskul lo// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// rā dza sid+dhi sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.a la la hoḥ hūm̐/ rin chen sna lnga'i gzhal yas 'dir// nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan khri la// bstan pa srung phyir bzhugs nas kyang*// bdag don ma lus yongs rdzogs mdzod// hūm̐/ rgyal chen mchod pa'i dam rdzas ni// nyer spyod 'dod yon bsam mi khyab// dkar mngar sman phud rdzing bur gtams// myos byed rak+ta'i rba klong 'khrugs// dmar gyi gtor ma lhun por spungs// dgra bo'i sha rus gcal du bkram// smyug rgod mda' dar rgyal mtshan sogs// spyan gzigs longs spyod mthun pa'i rdzas// dpag med dgyes rgur 'char ba'i sprin// yid 'phrog mchod pa rgya mtshos mchod// 'khor bcas thugs dam dgyes bskangs nas// ma g.yel brtse bas sdongs grogs mdzod// rā dza sid+dhi sa ma ya ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da pū dza hoḥ 'i bar gyi nyer spyod dang*/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ zhes sman raka stob/ rā dza sid+dhi sa ma ya dzaḥs pa ri wā ra i dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma phul la/ hūm̐/ sgrub mchog bdud 'dul thugs dam can// 'gro don legs nyes stangs 'dzin pa// dam nyams gdug pa kun gyi gshed// thogs med 'jigs byed khyod la bstod// skye med thugs kyi cho 'phrul las// sku rgyal mon bu pu tra dang*// yon tan rgyal po shing bya can// gsung gi rgyal chen dgra bla skyes// phrin las chos skyong pe ha ra// rnam rol cir yang 'char ba'i rgyan// so so'i sprul pa btsun mo blon// pho nya ru 'dren gar mkhan sogs// 'khor g.yog dpung tshogs bsam las 'das// snang srid dregs pa 'bangs su sdud// chos 'khor skyong ba'i g.yar dam can// mthu rtsal bdag po khyod la bstod// sngon tshe brag dmar ke'u tshang du// slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng gis// bka' bsgos dam tshig gnyer gtad bzhin// thugs dam gnyan po ma g.yel bar// snying po'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin sde// 'dus pa'i dge 'dun chos 'khor bcas// rtag tu bsrung zhing skyong ba dang*// bar chad mi mthun rkyen rnams sol// chos srid mnga' thang legs tshogs spel// skye 'gro'i snang ba dbang du sdus// mi bsrun log par lta ba'i dpung*// gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes// mtha' rtsa skye rgyud rtsad nas chod// phyogs las rnam rgyal dge mtshan gyi// grags pa'i ru mtshon dgung du phyor// mdor na rnal 'byor bdag cag gis// bcol pa'i las rnams ma lus pa// dus 'dir 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod//

ces bstod cing phrin las bcol/ mgron rang gnas su gshegs par bsam zhing mchod gtor gtsang sar 'bul lo// zhes pa'ang mngon par 'dod pa'i don la phrin las bskul ba'i phyir 'jigs bral ye shes rdo rjes spel ba dza yan+tu/// / ༈ dpe tshan 'di sngon chad gter mdzod dkyus su med cing*/ bal yul zhe dgon gyi par gsar 'dir gsar bzhag byas pas lung rgyun la zhib rtog dgos pa yin no//
